screen: End of carousel / first empty state — 'Create your first link'
job: Forward motion. Nothing has happened in the account yet and that is fine — she is already walking.

style.reference: Retro Halftone Editorial Line Illustration v1.0
style.medium: vector illustration emulating screen-print / risograph, flat paper grain, no gradients
style.line_work: heavy hand-inked black outlines 6-10px at 2048px canvas, moderate weight variation (thicker at joints and contact points), confident single-stroke, gently wobbly organic corners, rounded terminals, contours occasionally left open at intersections, minimal interior detail — 1 to 3 crease lines per shape
style.shading: coarse visible round halftone dots, ~45 LPI equivalent, 45 degree angle, ONE flat density per shape, never a gradient ramp
style.values: exactly three readable values — ground, halftone grey, solid black. Midtones are ALWAYS dithered dots, never flat grey.
style.figures: high abstraction, geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, mitten-simple fingers, small head relative to body, profile face with ONE curved-line eye, single bold nose and lip contour, no pupils, no nostrils, no ear detail, hair as a solid black graphic mass with a hard silhouette
style.value_separation: the figure reads as a solid-black garment against a halftone garment; the carried parcel is halftone with a solid black tape cross so it separates from the black top
style.accent_marks: three short motion dashes behind the back heel. Nothing else.
style.ground_line: one long horizontal ink line anchoring the scene, no drawn floor and no furniture legs
style.composition: flat, no perspective, no horizon, no background scenery, at least 35% empty ground, figure placed low and left with open ground ahead of her
style.text_policy: NO text, letters, numbers or symbols rendered inside the image — the app renders all copy in Plus Jakarta Sans

casting.context: Ghanaian social commerce — sellers trading through WhatsApp and Instagram DMs, mobile money, hand-wrapped parcels
casting.represent: Ghanaian adults, 20s to 40s, everyday sellers and buyers running a business
casting.avoid: tribal-print decoration, huts, drums, wildlife, poverty signifiers, aid imagery, generic 'African' motifs
casting.tone_rule: Purposeful walk, not a sprint. Confidence, not triumph.

scene.subject: a Ghanaian woman with a cropped afro
scene.pose: striding forward in profile, mid-step with one long leg extended, both oversized feet clearly drawn, unhurried
scene.props: a wrapped parcel tucked under one arm — halftone body with a solid black tape cross — and a slab phone held loose in the other hand as a plain solid black rectangle with no screen content
scene.accent_marks: three short motion dashes trailing the back heel
scene.placement: figure low and left, open empty ground ahead of her to the right

prompt: Retro mid-century editorial illustration on a flat #F1F1EF ground. A Ghanaian woman with a cropped afro strides forward in profile, mid-step with one long leg extended and both oversized feet clearly drawn, carrying a wrapped parcel tucked under one arm and a slab phone held loose in the other hand. Her top is solid black, her trousers are halftone dots, the parcel is halftone with a solid black tape cross. Three short motion dashes trail behind her back heel. Bold uneven hand-inked black outlines, flat solid black fills, coarse visible halftone dot shading, strictly three values, no color, no gradients, no soft shadows. Simplified geometric anatomy, exaggerated elongated limbs, oversized hands and feet, profile face with one curved-line eye and a bold minimal nose, solid black graphic hair. Single horizontal ground line. Square 1:1, generous negative space with the figure placed low and left and open ground ahead of her, screen-print risograph texture. No text anywhere in the image.
negative_prompt: flat grey fills instead of halftone dots
app UI on the phone screen
speed lines across the whole frame

caption_variant.when: social posts, App Store screenshots, landing page — NOT in-app
caption_variant.caption: first link.
caption_variant.add_to_prompt: Large lowercase bold Helvetica Neue caption 'first link.' set flush-left in the upper-left with very tight leading, generous margin from the edge, never overlapping the figure.

qa_checklist: Walking, not running — no sprint or jump pose
Open ground ahead of the figure, not behind her
Parcel halftone separates from the solid black top
Exactly three values present — no fourth grey
Every midtone is visibly dotted at 100% zoom
